# High Heel Door Wedge

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model of a stylized high heel shoe designed to function as a sturdy door wedge (doorstop). It features a solid heel block for durability, a low-profile 4mm toe tip for sliding cleanly under doors, and a support-free hollow foot cavity engineered with a parametric internal bridging angle to prevent bottom holes and print cleanly without supports.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)

## Key Parameters
- `length` (180mm): Total length of the shoe wedge.
- `width` (57mm): Maximum width at the ball of the shoe.
- `height` (95mm): Total height at the back of the heel.
- `wall_thickness` (5mm): Wall thickness around the hollow cavity.
- `toe_coverage` (85mm): Distance the top vamp cover extends from the tip.
- `vamp_h` (45mm): Height of the shoe opening where the wedge engages the door.
- `overhang_angle` (30°): Internal bridging angle for support-free 3D printing.
- `heel_width` (40mm): Width of the solid heel block.
- `arch_h` (35mm): Height of the arch cutout underneath.
